PERQUISITION // ATELIER ADLER, BLOC 7,: SEARCH  //  ADLER'S WORKSHOP, BLOCK 7, GROUND FLOOR
Le scellé de la Milice pend, déjà décoll:
The Militia seal hangs loose, already peeled off. The workshop smells of fine oil and brass. Clocks everywhere, and not one is ticking: the Militia stopped them all during the round-up.

You know this door. As a child you waited here while your father finished talking with old ADLER.
Vingt pendules arrêtées, toutes sur la m:
Twenty stopped clocks, all at the same time: the time of the round-up, 05h20. All but one, small, in pale wood, stopped at 06h05. Its hands were fixed by hand, with a thread.

06h05. The drawing in the SEDLARs' stove. The one in your stairwell.
L'établi et les fiches de réparation: The workbench and the repair cards
Sous la loupe, une boîte de fiches. La p: Under the magnifier, a box of cards. The clock of School No. 4, the time clock of the shoe factory, the clock of the central station: all ordered by State services, all paid at the official rate, stamped. A repairman, not a network.
La pendule sous le drap, sur l'étagère: The clock under the sheet, on the shelf
Sous le drap, une pendule de voyage. Éti:
Under the sheet, a travel clock. Label: "A. VOSK — left March 1971". In the case, where the pendulum should be, a sheet of paper folded in eight, in your father's handwriting:

"Room 3 and corridor B: − 12 min on arrest nights. Set BY ORDER. Who signs the order? Ask K."

K.
Le lit d'ADLER, fait au carré. Sous l'or: ADLER's bed, made with square corners. Under the pillow, a photo: ADLER, your father, and a nine-year-old child at the foot of the station clock. The child is you. You didn't remember this photo. Nothing for the file.
Le double fond de l'armoire: The false back of the wardrobe
Le fond de l'armoire sonne creux. Derriè:
The back of the wardrobe sounds hollow. Behind it, a school exercise book: names, dates, times. "M. 12.10: clocked in 06h05 instead of 06h40." "T. family: 22h40 train held." The people THE TRUE HOUR covered for.

Your pen is already on the report. The book goes into the file.
Vous recollez le scellé de la Milice, ma: You stick the Militia seal back on, badly. On the stairs, a neighbour watches you come down. She will say she saw you leave ADLER's. She will also say you were alone.
Le carton d'origine du poste saisi, avec: The original box of the seized set, with its leaflet: "VELMIRA 3 receiver — medium and long wave". No short wave. The "short wave" label in the seizure report was written by the Militia.
